702.noahz: Dorian Noahz introduced himself as a tailor from Northwick. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice. Orders assigned Dorian Noahz to work as a machine gunner. The first lesson began with what not to touch.
johnrant21: Nobody asked Clement "Lucky" Johnrant why he came. Nobody in S-F16 asks that. He was handed a spade before he was handed a rifle.

A bucket appeared above the Concord parapet at the Drowned Farm. Isidor Lowelleast fired; Clement "Lucky" Johnrant pulled the bucket down. A sign later appeared: 'Water costs enough already.' Clement "Lucky" Johnrant walked the captured trenches of Verdel Ridge and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant fired at a movement across the wire at S-F16. The man went down: Rafael "Owl" Zelenszki, grazed.
Clement "Lucky" Johnrant began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
lettersabcd: Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd told the sergeant he was a dance-hall violinist. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed more rain, and put him on sentry.
First Wave. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd signed when the posters were still wet. He keeps the ribbon wrapped in oilcloth with a frozen apple.
Victory at Verdel Ridge. Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
The party came back from Sorrow Copse by different routes. By dawn, everyone had been accounted for except Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd.
The missing report was still on the desk when Ivo "Ghost" Lettersabcd walked in. The clerk crossed it out hard enough to tear the paper.
the_john_military: Emil Military came from Halden, where there is a river, a church and no mud at all. He talks about all three as if they were people.

The patrol came back one man at a time. Emil Military held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. A letter from home reached Emil Military before dusk. Emil Military read it twice and slept a little easier.
thebutcher5655: Benedikt "Saint" Thebutcher arrived on Day 5 as a replacement. The men in R-S9 had been fighting for 4 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
virajvirxgill13: Nobody saw Jakub Virajvirxgil arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in R-F16, and a quiet machine gunner under it.
Jakub Virajvirxgil and Albin Chloe shared the last tin of bully beef in the bay, counting the bites out loud to keep it fair.

Lightning lit the Chalk Pits and Jakub Virajvirxgil saw the enemy wire, the enemy trench, and a man in it looking straight back. News of the loss of Verdel Ridge reached R-F16 with the rations. Jakub Virajvirxgil ate while listening to the revised orders.
The guns found R-F16. Jakub Virajvirxgil was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet.
Jakub Virajvirxgil lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk.
